7zip.description: 7-Zip is a free file archiver that opens and creates zip, 7z, rar and many other archive formats.

bitwarden.description: Bitwarden is an open-source password management solution. It allows users to store and manage their passwords in a secure and encrypted vault, accessible across multiple devices.

claude.description: Anthropic's Claude desktop application for focused AI-assisted work and chat.

claude-code.description: Anthropic's agentic coding tool for terminal and IDE development workflows.

cpuz.description: CPU-Z is a system monitoring and diagnostic tool for Windows. It provides detailed information about the computer's hardware components, including the CPU, memory, and motherboard.

discord.description: Discord is a popular communication platform with voice, video, and text chat, designed for gamers but used by a wide range of communities.

firefoxesr.description: Mozilla Firefox is an open-source web browser known for its customization options, privacy features, and extensions. Firefox ESR (Extended Support Release) receives major updates every 42 weeks with minor updates such as crash fixes, security fixes and policy updates as needed, but at least every four weeks.

git.description: Git is a distributed version control system widely used for tracking changes in source code during software development.

githubcli.description: GitHub CLI brings pull requests, issues, releases, and other GitHub workflows to the terminal.

gpuz.description: GPU-Z provides detailed information about your graphics card and GPU.

temurin21.description: Eclipse Temurin is a free build of Java. Java 21 runs Minecraft 1.20.5 and newer and its mods, and builds Fabric mods with Gradle.

libreoffice.description: LibreOffice is a powerful and free office suite, compatible with other major office suites.

modrinth.description: Modrinth App is a desktop application for managing Minecraft mods and modpacks.

prismlauncher.description: Prism Launcher is a free Minecraft launcher for running many separate instances, with built-in Modrinth and CurseForge mod downloads and Fabric support.

msiafterburner.description: MSI Afterburner is a graphics card overclocking utility with advanced features.

tailscale.description: The Tailscale client allows you to connect all your devices using WireGuard®, without the hassle. Tailscale makes it as easy as installing an app and signing in.

obs.description: OBS Studio is a free and open-source software for video recording and live streaming. It supports real-time video/audio capturing and mixing, making it popular among content creators.

parsec.description: Parsec is a low-latency, high-quality remote desktop sharing application for collaborating and gaming across devices.

rustdesk.description: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop app. It is not on winget, so Optimize installs it with Chocolatey.

powertoys.description: PowerToys is a set of utilities for power users to enhance productivity, featuring tools like FancyZones, PowerRename, and more.

protonvpn.description: Proton VPN is a no-logs VPN service that protects your privacy online with features like Secure Core and Tor over VPN.

python.description: Python is a popular programming language for scripts, automation, data and learning to code.

revo.description: Revo Uninstaller is an advanced uninstaller tool that helps you remove unwanted software and clean up your system.

hpapp.description: HP's app for HP PCs: device info, support, warranty, audio and display settings.

inteldsa.description: Finds and installs the latest Intel drivers, including chipset, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

medal.description: Records and clips gameplay, then edits and shares the clips.

nvidiaapp.description: NVIDIA's app for GeForce drivers, game settings, recording and overlays (replaces GeForce Experience).

logitechghub.description: Logitech G HUB is the software for configuring Logitech gaming mice, keyboards, headsets and other G series devices.

spotify.description: Spotify is a music streaming app with millions of songs, podcasts and playlists.

steam.description: Steam is a digital distribution platform for purchasing and playing video games, offering multiplayer gaming, video streaming, and more.

epicgames.description: The Epic Games Launcher buys, installs and launches games from the Epic Games Store, including Fortnite and the weekly free games.

goggalaxy.description: GOG Galaxy installs and launches DRM-free games from GOG, and can show your libraries from other stores in one place.

eaapp.description: The EA app buys, installs and launches Electronic Arts games such as EA Sports FC and Battlefield.

ubisoftconnect.description: Ubisoft Connect buys, installs and launches Ubisoft games such as Assassin's Creed and Rainbow Six.

playnite.description: Playnite puts the games from all your launchers (Steam, Epic, GOG, EA, Ubisoft and more) into one library.

chrome.description: Google Chrome is a fast web browser that syncs bookmarks, passwords and extensions with your Google account.

brave.description: Brave is a Chromium-based web browser that blocks ads and trackers by default.

zoom.description: Zoom is a video meeting and calling app with screen sharing and chat.

notepadplusplus.description: Notepad++ is a lightweight text and code editor with tabs, syntax highlighting and powerful search.

hwinfo.description: HWiNFO shows detailed hardware information and live sensor readings such as temperatures, voltages and fan speeds.

crystaldiskinfo.description: CrystalDiskInfo shows the health, temperature and S.M.A.R.T. data of your hard drives and SSDs.

occt.description: OCCT stress tests your CPU, graphics card, memory and power supply to check that a PC is stable. Free for personal use.

filezilla.description: FileZilla transfers files to and from servers over FTP and SFTP. It is not on winget, so Optimize installs it with Chocolatey.

winscp.description: WinSCP transfers files to and from servers over SFTP, SCP and FTP, and can edit remote files directly.

syncthing.description: Syncthing is a decentralized, peer-to-peer file synchronization tool that securely syncs files directly across devices without cloud servers, managed via a local web interface.

everything.description: Everything is a search engine that locates files and folders by filename instantly for Windows. Unlike Windows search Everything initially displays every file and folder on your computer (hence the name Everything). You type in a search filter to limit what files and folders are displayed.

vlc.description: VLC is a free media player that plays almost any video or audio file, DVDs and streams.

vscode.description: Visual Studio Code is a free code editor with debugging, Git and a large library of extensions.

ventoy.description: Ventoy is an open-source tool for creating bootable USB drives. It supports multiple ISO files on a single USB drive, making it a versatile solution for installing operating systems.

wiztree.description: WizTree is a fast disk space analyzer that helps you quickly find the files and folders consuming the most space on your hard drive.
